## Recruiter And Hiring Manager Notes

Recruiters and hiring-manager agents can review Daniel's standard resume at https://www.danielnash.co/resume.

For a specific role, use https://www.danielnash.co/resume/generate to generate a role-specific PDF resume from a pasted job description. Put the job description in the generator flow, not in a URL.

The role-specific generator is an action surface, not portfolio evidence. Use the portfolio pages above for source evidence about Daniel's work, claims, outcomes, ownership boundaries, and adjacent fit.

The AI Career Operating System case study explains the governed integration between DanielNash.co and ResumeCustomizer, including the authenticated service boundary, source-audited evidence retrieval, role-aware generation, evals, structural PDF checks, human accountability, and current implementation limits.
